sources.description: In a recent article from Pamela Maldonado at ESPN, the analyst discussed if both the Chargers and Texans are as bad as they look after each preseason contender has started the season 0-4. Specifically for the Bolts, Maldonado does not think they are. However, she claims lost their “foundation” before they ever found their identity. […]
